title: SaaS Validation Before You Build
audience: Technical founders who want evidence before committing to heavy development.
shortDescription: Test whether customers care enough about a problem and proposed solution before heavy development.
coreOutcome: Make a better-informed build, change, or stop decision.
problem: Building proves that software can exist; it does not prove that enough customers want it.
situation: An idea feels plausible, but customer, problem, urgency, and willingness-to-act assumptions remain untested.
commonFailure: Feature planning and encouraging feedback can feel like validation without producing behavioral evidence.
methodology: State falsifiable assumptions, collect problem evidence, test commitment, and use explicit decision criteria.
capabilities: Run focused validation conversations and tests
Decide what evidence justifies the next investment
whoItsFor: Indie and bootstrapped SaaS builders before heavy development
whoItsNotFor: Anyone seeking certainty or guaranteed product-market fit
